evidence.api: toml_parse(char *conf, char *errbuf, int errbufsz) on a NUL-terminated copy; toml_key_in/toml_*_in/toml_*_at accessors
evidence.cause: toml.c (scan_string, lines 1695-1699 and 1744-1748) accepts only uppercase hex digits after \u/\U ("0123456789ABCDEF"); the control writes \u00e9, which TOML 1.0.0 HEXDIG allows. A diagnostic copy with \u00E9 (control unchanged) produced the expected tree, so this is the only difference on the two controls.
evidence.harness_route: local clang build of the same typed-tree harness used for the promoted C paths; no Docker receipt recorded
